name: Whispers and Wagers
source:
You're forced into a deadly game where secrets seduce and trust kills. To survive, you'll have to play dirty, love dangerously, and risk everything.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你被迫进入一场致命的游戏，秘密引诱，信任杀人。为了生存，你必须玩弄肮脏的行为，危险地去爱，并冒一切风险。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
